name: orderhub
description: OrderHub for Claude — read-only briefings, queues, order lookups, and sales metrics. Skill layer of the two-plugin model; pair with the OrderHub Authenticator plugin generated from orderhub.pixfizz.com for Cowork / Claude Desktop.

api_token.title: OrderHub access token (Claude Code only)
api_token.description: For Claude Code users only — generate a Personal access token at https://orderhub.pixfizz.com/organizations (API tab). Cowork and Claude Desktop users do NOT paste a token here; they install the OrderHub Authenticator plugin instead.
